title: CFU/mL

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Converts a raw colony count on a plate into an estimate of viable colony-forming units per mL of the original sample, correcting for both the volume plated and how diluted that plate's inoculum was relative to the original sample.

variables.meaning: Number of colonies counted on the plate
Dilution factor of the plated sample (e.g. 10⁻³ for a 1:1000 dilution)

workedExample.scenario: 142 colonies counted on a plate from a 10⁻⁴ dilution, with 0.1 mL plated.

commonMistakes: Forgetting to include the volume plated (using only the dilution factor) when it is not exactly 1 mL.
Mixing up the dilution factor with the dilution notation's denominator (0.1 vs. 10, for a 1:10 dilution).
